name: Marco
description: A curious kid who just learned the rules last week. He loves moving his knights in random directions and forgets to protect his queen. Perfect for your very first game.

name: The Librarian
description: She has read every chess book in the library but never played a real game. Her openings are textbook-perfect, but the middlegame is anyone's guess.

name: Old Rook
description: A retired postal worker who plays at the park every Sunday. He knows all the endgame basics and will grind you down slowly if you give him the chance.

name: Elena
description: A university student studying mathematics. She plays sharp Sicilian lines and is dangerous with open files. Expect relentless pressure once she gets an initiative.

name: The Ghost
description: Nobody knows who he is. He shows up in online tournaments, demolishes everyone, then disappears. His style is cold, efficient, and deeply positional.

name: Iron Queen
description: A former national champion who never stopped playing. She sacrifices material without hesitation and punishes the slightest inaccuracy with surgical precision.

name: The Oracle
description: A machine mind wrapped in mystery. Its moves seem impossibly deep, as if it sees ten moves ahead by instinct. Few players have ever survived past move thirty.

name: The Mirror
description: A bot built by cloning a real Lichess player's style. It adapts its aggression, depth and opening repertoire to mimic how that player actually moves. Eerie to play against.
